Notes

copped matching kicks

To cop something is to buy or get it; kicks are sneakers. “Matching” makes the purchase a small sign of friendship, not just another item in the verse’s designer inventory.

  • Genius community lyric text
stay out the mix

To stay out of the mix is to keep away from the surrounding drama, entanglements, or social scene. The next lines’ keeping to himself and keeping his people close make this a selective distance from others.

  • Genius community lyric text
D&G top and Kiko on the pants

D&G abbreviates Dolce & Gabbana. “Kiko” most likely refers to designer Kiko Kostadinov and his clothing label, which sells menswear and trousers. These are compressed outfit credits; the lyric gives no specific garment model.

  • Genius community lyric text
  • Dolce & Gabbana: company code of ethics
  • Kiko Kostadinov: menswear
then I dip

Dip means leave or head out. The quick sequence—perform, collect the check, leave—matches the verse’s preference for privacy over hanging around the scene.

  • Genius community lyric text
OT new country just so we can take us a flick

OT means out of town here; a flick is a photo. Going as far as another country just for a picture turns ordinary hanging out into a casually extravagant travel boast.

  • Genius community lyric text
I'm the first round pick, you not part of the draft

The draft selects players for sports teams; a first-round pick is among the earliest selections. The boast then pushes the rival even lower: not merely selected late, but unable to get onto a team’s roster at all.

  • Genius community lyric text
fried

Fried can mean mentally exhausted, overwhelmed, or very intoxicated. The inability to process what someone said fits that impaired state, but the line does not settle which sense or identify a substance.

  • Genius community lyric text
run that shit up

In the money context, run it up means increase the amount—build the earnings or balance. It is a compact ambition to turn getting paid into continued financial progress.

  • Genius community lyric text
细嚼慢咽

Literally chewing thoroughly and swallowing slowly. Next to 获取养分 (“take in nourishment”), it develops a food image before he casts himself as a dessert.

  • Genius community lyric text
一点演都不带演的

演 is to act or perform. This colloquial construction emphatically says he is not putting on a show or pretending.

  • Genius community lyric text
用料

用料 normally describes materials or ingredients used to make something. Read alongside “dessert” and the title, he presents himself as something made to a distinctive recipe.

  • Genius community lyric text
